# RapidAPI listing

Copy for the RapidAPI Hub provider listing of the CalcBloc API. Read the gateway note in PUBLISHING_CHECKLIST.md (section 5) before going live: the API's own keys and per-IP limits need a decision for RapidAPI traffic.

## Name

CalcBloc Tax Tables and Take-Home Pay

## Short description

Official income tax brackets and social security rates for 29 countries, plus net pay and employer cost.

## Long description

The CalcBloc API returns **official tax tables** and **payroll calculations** from the same data and engines as calcbloc.com.

- **Tax tables** for 29 countries (2026 and 2026-27 tax years): income tax brackets, personal allowances and credits, employee and employer social security contribution rates with their ceilings, and other payroll figures, with regional tables for states, provinces and cantons. Every row includes its official source URL, retrieval date and review status. JSON or CSV.
- **Take-home pay** (`/net-salary`): net pay from a gross salary, with income tax, social security and the main country-specific options.
- **Employer cost** (`/employer-cost`): the total cost of employing someone, with employer contributions and payroll taxes.
- **Compare** (`/compare`): the same salary in two countries.
- **Countries** (`/countries`): supported countries, regions, tax years and parameters.

Rates are decimals (0.2 = 20%), amounts are in the country's currency, and every response includes an attribution block. Free use requires a visible "Data by CalcBloc" link to calcbloc.com wherever the figures are shown (terms: https://calcbloc.com/developers/terms?utm_source=calcbloc-data&utm_medium=listing&utm_campaign=itmarkerz-oss).

## Category

Finance (secondary tags: Data, Tax, Payroll)

## Base URL

`https://calcbloc.com/api/v1` when the endpoints are entered by hand (paths as below). When the OpenAPI document is imported, use `https://calcbloc.com`: its paths already start with `/api/v1`.

## Endpoints

| Method | Path | What it returns | Key |
|---|---|---|---|
| GET | `/countries` | Supported countries, regions, years and parameters | Optional |
| GET | `/tax-tables/{country}/{year}` | Official tax tables for a country and tax year; `region` and `format=json\|csv` optional; `year` may be `latest` | Optional |
| GET | `/net-salary?country=&salary=` | Take-home pay for a salary | Required (documented) |
| GET | `/employer-cost?country=&salary=` | Total cost of employing someone | Required (documented) |
| GET | `/compare?a=&b=&salary=` | The same salary in two countries | Required (documented) |

Authentication: `X-API-Key` header (keys in the URL are refused). The calculation endpoints cover fewer countries than the tax tables; `/countries` lists them.

## OpenAPI

https://calcbloc.com/api/openapi.json (OpenAPI 3.1; RapidAPI Studio can import it. The path `/api/v1/openapi.json` redirects there.)

## Pricing note

Suggested: a free BASIC plan only, mirroring the direct free tier (5,000 requests a day, 60 a minute), with attribution required. Paid plans only once commercial terms (higher volumes, no attribution) are set; until then point commercial users to hello@calcbloc.com. Check RapidAPI's current marketplace fee before pricing a paid plan.
